dimensions.label: Delivered DiaSources per DiaObject
dimensions.definition: Count of delivered DiaSource rows grouped by diaObjectId within the admitted window.
qualifications: Light Static carries no complete history; this is not a lifetime detection count.

dimensions.label: Delivered time baseline
dimensions.definition: last − first midpointMjdTai of delivered DiaSources (TAI day difference).
qualifications: Bounded by the admitted window; not the object's full baseline.

dimensions.label: Peak difference-flux magnitude
qualifications: Difference-image flux, not a total magnitude; undefined without a positive psfFlux.

dimensions.label: g − r (mean difference-flux mag)
dimensions.definition: Mean positive-psfFlux AB magnitude in g minus that in r over delivered DiaSources.
qualifications: Difference-image fluxes; not a source colour.
Requires positive flux in both bands.

dimensions.label: Reduced χ² about weighted mean (r)
dimensions.definition: lc_features["r"].chi2 from the latest delivered source-time snapshot in this basis.
qualifications: Requires ≥ 3 r-band DiaSources in the snapshot history; otherwise undefined.
dimensions.snapshot: Latest delivered snapshot; features summarize the history visible to Fink at that alert time, not a timeless object property.

dimensions.label: Skewness (r)

qualifications: Requires ≥ 3 r-band DiaSources in the snapshot history; otherwise undefined.
dimensions.snapshot: Latest delivered snapshot; features summarize the history visible to Fink at that alert time, not a timeless object property.

qualifications: Model score, not a calibrated probability.
dimensions.snapshot: Latest delivered snapshot; classifier outputs change as alerts arrive and are not timeless classifications.

dimensions.label: Galactic latitude b
dimensions.definition: Galactic latitude of the native entity position (ICRS -> Galactic, Astropy/Hipparcos rotation).

dimensions.label: Ecliptic latitude β
dimensions.definition: Mean ecliptic latitude of J2000.0 of the native entity position (ICRS frame bias ignored).

dimensions.label: Forced photometry / upper limits
dimensions.unavailable_reason: analysis_contract_v1 lists forced photometry / upper limits as a known absent capability of Light Static.

dimensions.label: Lifetime detection count
dimensions.definition: All historical detections of the DiaObject.
dimensions.unavailable_reason: analysis_contract_v1 lists complete historical detections as a known absent capability.
